ja.title: AlphaProtein Novoで実験に回す酵素候補をどう絞るか
ja.summary: 反応機構を設計入力にするAlphaProtein Novoを読み解く。構造指標と活性の違い、複数配列による足場評価、ヒット率の分母を整理し、公開された件数から参考区間を再計算する。
ja.seo_title: AlphaProtein Novoで実験に回す酵素候補をどう絞るか

en.title: How does AlphaProtein Novo select enzymes for experimental testing?
en.summary: A source-based examination of catalytic motifs, structural metrics, sequence ensembles and denominators in enzyme design. Reported counts are recalculated; no model inference or enzyme experiments were performed.
en.seo_title: How AlphaProtein Novo selects enzymes for testing
en.seo_description: Catalytic motifs, structural filters and experimental hit-rate denominators in AlphaProtein Novo. Reported counts are recalculated without model execution.
